lines.cap: Mum said, five minutes. Just milk.
lines.say: Mum said, five minutes. Just milk.

lines.cap: Just milk. Five minutes. Wait outside.
lines.say: Just milk. Five minutes. Wait outside.

lines.cap: I have heard this before. I am not ready.
lines.say: I have heard this before. I am not ready.

lines.cap: Then she sees an old friend.
lines.say: Then she sees an old friend.

lines.cap: Sunita! Twenty years! How is your son? Still not married?
lines.say: Sunita! Twenty years! How is your son? Still not married?

lines.cap: Don't ask. Come, tell me everything.
lines.say: Don't ask. Come, tell me everything.

lines.cap: Minute forty. The sun is setting. I am growing a beard.
lines.say: Minute forty. The sun is setting. I am growing a beard.

lines.cap: Two hours later, they come home. Without the milk.
lines.say: Two hours later, they come home. Without the milk.

lines.cap: We forgot the milk. Go get it. Five minutes.
lines.say: We forgot the milk. Go get it. Five minutes.

lines.cap: Tag your mum. She said, five minutes.
lines.say: Tag your mum. She said, five minutes.
